sentences.en: It sounds as if genius compensates for lack of experience.
sentences.zh: 这听起来像是天才能够弥补经验不足。

sentences.en: Victims have the right to be compensated for their damages.
I'm going bald. Hmm. What can I do to compensate?
sentences.zh: 我开始秃顶了。嗯。我能做些什么来补偿呢？

mnemonic: 词根记忆：com（全部）+pens（花费）+ ate（做）→花费的钱全部（拿回来）→补偿

collocations.en: compensate the consumer for the loss
